A '''golden pickaxe''' is a [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]] of the [[Golden equipment|golden]] tier, crafted from three [[gold ingot]]s and two sticks. It mines very fast and comes with [[Fortune]] I, but wears out quickly.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe blocks at speed {{Value|Golden Pickaxe|miningspeed}}, faster than a [[diamond pickaxe]] (9), and has {{Value|Golden Pickaxe|durability}} durability. Unlike the vanilla golden pickaxe, which is limited to wooden-tier blocks, it harvests every ore. It gets no drops from obsidian, crying obsidian or ender chests, which break at speed 3.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/golden_pickaxe.json}}</ref>

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Enchantments ===
It has Fortune I. Golden gear comes with its enchantments already applied. They are ordinary enchantments, so they can be combined or removed like any other.

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Golden Pickaxe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Golden Pickaxe|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[gold ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one gold ingot.
